description: A design with a controller for HTTP, a service for rules and a repository for storage, each depending on the layer below.
A repository implementation that keeps data in a map for one run, behind an interface that a database version can later replace.
A custom exception such as CourseNotFoundException that the service throws and the advice maps to a status.
A @RestControllerAdvice that turns every failure into an application/problem+json response with a stable type.
Concrete, checkable statements with fixed test data that define when the project is done.
Using @DirtiesContext so each MockMvc test starts with a fresh application context and empty in-memory data.
The OpenAPI JSON served at /v3/api-docs, with operation ids that client generators turn into method names.
